zh-CN.summary: 兼容 OpenAI 的模型网关，搭配 PostgreSQL，并预先建好所有者账号。

zh-TW.summary: 相容 OpenAI 的模型閘道，搭配 PostgreSQL，並先建好擁有者帳號。

metadata.name: New API
metadata.summary: An OpenAI-compatible model gateway with PostgreSQL and an owner account ready.

zh-CN.summary: 所有东西都在自己的命名空间里运行。镜像以 digest 固定版本，工作负载都用非 root 用户运行，网络访问压到最低，也没有默认密码。

zh-TW.summary: 所有東西都在自己的命名空間裡執行。映像檔以 digest 固定版本，工作負載都用非 root 使用者執行，網路存取壓到最低，也沒有預設密碼。

zh-CN.mitigation: Pod 就绪可以接收流量之前，PostStart hook 会先用自动生成的密码调用官方支持的 /api/setup。这个设置流程不会留下任何已知的 root 凭据。
zh-CN.risk: 公开网站如果还没完成初始设置，第一个来的访客就能接管管理员账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: Pod 準備好接收流量之前，PostStart hook 會先用自動產生的密碼呼叫官方支援的 /api/setup。這個設定流程不會留下任何已知的 root 認證資訊。
zh-TW.risk: 公開網站如果還沒完成初始設定，第一個來的訪客就能接管管理員帳號。

risks.mitigation: A PostStart hook calls the supported /api/setup endpoint with a generated password before the Pod is ready to receive traffic. The setup creates no known root credential.
risks.risk: If the public site is not set up yet, the first visitor could take over the administrator account.

zh-CN.mitigation: 管理员和服务商的配置权限要严格控制。应用以非 root 运行，文件系统只读，也没有 Kubernetes 令牌。会话和加密用的机密都是自动生成，PostgreSQL 连接使用经过验证的 TLS。如果你改过代码又让别人通过网络使用，请确认 AGPL 要求你提供源码的义务。
zh-CN.risk: 网关会处理服务商的 API 密钥、账号和计费数据。你配置的服务商可能把敏感的提示词发到外部。

zh-TW.mitigation: 管理員和服務商的設定權限要嚴格控管。應用程式用非 root 執行，檔案系統唯讀，也沒有 Kubernetes 權杖。登入工作階段和加密用的機密都是自動產生，PostgreSQL 連線使用經過驗證的 TLS。如果你改過程式碼又讓別人透過網路使用，請確認 AGPL 要求你提供原始碼的義務。
zh-TW.risk: 閘道會處理服務商的 API 金鑰、帳號和計費資料。你設定的服務商可能把敏感的提示詞傳到外部。

risks.mitigation: Limit who can be an administrator and who can define providers. The app runs as non-root with a read-only filesystem and no Kubernetes token. Session and encryption secrets are generated, and PostgreSQL uses verified TLS. Check the AGPL obligation to offer your source code if you let others use a modified version over the network.
risks.risk: The gateway handles provider API keys, accounts and billing data. The providers you configure can send sensitive prompts to outside services.

zh-CN.mitigation: 只有 operator 创建的数据库 Pod 拿得到令牌。New API 的 Pod 已关闭自动挂载令牌。
zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）需要令牌才能调用 Kubernetes API。

zh-TW.mitigation: 只有 operator 建立的資料庫 Pod 拿得到權杖。New API 的 Pod 已關閉自動掛載權杖。
zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）需要權杖才能呼叫 Kubernetes API。

risks.mitigation: Only the database pods created by the operator get a token. The New API Pod has token mounting turned off.
risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) need a token to call the Kubernetes API.

security.summary: Everything runs in its own namespace. Images are pinned by digest and workloads run as non-root users. Network access is kept to the minimum. There are no default passwords.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: new-api
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: new-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: new-api
        app: new-api
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: new-api
        image: docker.io/calciumion/new-api:v1.0.0-rc.46@sha256:abf1f675efa1847b90c049c03766e2daaf62a78998aae3625cf34b6a045b1b97
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 2000m
            memory: 1Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: db-ca
          mountPath: /db-ca
          readOnly: true
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 3000
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 3000
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - test -f /tmp/setup-complete && wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/status
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/status
            port: 3000
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 6
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: newapi-db-app
              key: password
        - name: SQL_DSN
          value: postgres://newapi:$(DATABASE_PASSWORD)@newapi-db-rw:5432/newapi?sslmode=verify-full&sslrootcert=/db-ca/ca.crt
        - name: SESSION_SECRET
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: newapi-secrets
              key: session-secret
        - name: CRYPTO_SECRET
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: newapi-secrets
              key: crypto-secret
        - name: INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: newapi-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: TZ
          value: Asia/Taipei
        args:
        - --log-dir
        - /data/logs
        lifecycle:
          postStart:
            exec:
              command:
              - /bin/sh
              - -ec
              - "set -eu\nn=0\nuntil wget -q -O /tmp/setup-state.json http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/setup; do\n  n=$((n+1));\
                \ [ \"$n\" -lt 120 ] || exit 1; sleep 2\ndone\nif ! grep -Eq '\"status\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'\
                \ /tmp/setup-state.json; then\n  payload=$(printf '{\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"Aa1-%s\"\
                ,\"confirmPassword\":\"Aa1-%s\",\"SelfUseModeEnabled\":true,\"DemoSiteEnabled\":false}' \"$INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"\
                \ \"$INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n  wget -q -O /tmp/setup-result.json --header='Content-Type: application/json'\
                \ --post-data=\"$payload\" http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/setup\n  grep -Eq '\"success\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'\
                \ /tmp/setup-result.json\nfi\nrm -f /tmp/setup-state.json /tmp/setup-result.json\ntouch /tmp/setup-complete\n"
      volumes:
      - name: data
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
      - name: db-ca
        secret:
          secretName: newapi-db-ca
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: new-api
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app: new-api
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 3000
    targetPort: 3000
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: new-api
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints: websecure
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.tls: 'true'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: new-api-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: new-api
            port:
              number: 3000
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: newapi-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: new-api
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:17@sha256:70664ebcfa1100361b5bdc28bbf06fdbe08db2dc4ad7bd14de33c5e05fe8ea8e
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: newapi
      owner: newapi
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 1000m
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
